summary: ArriVent BioPharma filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 7.01 and incorporating it into Item 8.01, disclosing topline results from the Phase 3 FURVENT trial of firmonertinib monotherapy in previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC harboring EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations. The trial missed its primary endpoint of progression-free survival by blinded independent central review, though investigator-assessed PFS, confirmed objective response rate, and an immature overall survival trend favored the drug; no new safety signals emerged. No deal, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is an ordinary clinical program update, not a special situation; watch for regulatory and partnering implications.
